title: 浪淘沙慢·梦觉透窗风一线
title_en: Lang Tao Sha Man: Waking from a Dream, a Thread of Wind Through the Window
author: 柳永

form.zh: 词，词牌《浪淘沙慢》，三叠一百三十五字
form.en: ci to the tune Lang Tao Sha Man, 135 characters in three stanzas

text_note.zh: 这里用的整理本题作《浪淘沙》，通行本题作《浪淘沙慢》，因为它是长调慢词，和常见的短调《浪淘沙》不同。“殢云尤雨”的“殢”，整理本是一个生僻的异体字，这里照通行本写作“殢”。
text_note.en: The edition used here titles it Lang Tao Sha. The common text calls it Lang Tao Sha Man, because it is a long slow lyric, different from the short tune Lang Tao Sha. In tì yún yóu yǔ, the edition uses a rare variant form of the first character; this page uses the common form.

readings.zh: “梦觉”是从梦里醒来，读 jué，不是“睡觉”的 jiào。
readings.en: Mèng jué means waking from a dream, so this character is read jué, not jiào as in "to sleep".

readings.zh: “那堪”是“哪里受得了”的意思，读 nǎ，同“哪”。
readings.en: Nǎ kān means "how can one bear", so this character is read nǎ.
This character means "she" and is read yī.

readings.zh: 殢读 tì，是“纠缠、留恋不放”的意思。
readings.en: This rare character is read tì and means to cling to, to linger over.

readings.zh: “数寒更”是一更一更地数着时间，“数”是动词，读 shǔ。
readings.en: Shǔ hán gēng means counting the cold night watches one by one, so this character is a verb, read shǔ.

readings.zh: “寒更”的“更”是夜里的计时单位，读 gēng，不是“更加”的 gèng。
readings.en: In hán gēng this character is a night watch, a unit of night time, so it is read gēng, not gèng as in "even more".

glosses.zh: 梦觉：从梦中醒来。
glosses.en: mèng jué: waking from a dream.

glosses.zh: 风一线：一丝细细的风，从窗缝里钻进来。
glosses.en: fēng yī xiàn: a thin thread of wind slipping in through a crack in the window.

glosses.zh: 吹息：把灯吹灭了。息，熄灭。
glosses.en: chuī xī: blowing the lamp out. Xī means to go out.

glosses.zh: 那堪：哪里受得了。
glosses.en: nǎ kān: how can one bear it.

glosses.zh: 空阶：空荡荡的台阶。
glosses.en: kōng jiē: the empty steps outside.

glosses.zh: 频滴：一滴接一滴，不停地滴。
glosses.en: pín dī: dripping again and again.

glosses.zh: 嗟：唉，叹气的声音。
glosses.en: jiē: alas, a sound of sighing.

glosses.zh: 因循：拖拖拉拉，一直没有改变。
glosses.en: yīn xún: putting things off, letting things drift.

glosses.zh: 天涯客：漂泊在远方的游子。天涯，天边，指很远的地方。
glosses.en: tiān yá kè: a traveller far from home. Tiān yá, "the edge of the sky", means a very distant place.

glosses.zh: 负：辜负，对不起别人的情意。
glosses.en: fù: to let someone down, to fail their love.

glosses.zh: 几许盟言：多少山盟海誓。盟言，相爱的人许下的誓言。
glosses.en: jǐ xǔ méng yán: so many vows. Méng yán are promises lovers make to each other.

glosses.zh: 便忍把：竟然忍心把。
glosses.en: biàn rěn bǎ: how could I bear to take.

glosses.zh: 欢会：快乐的相聚。
glosses.en: huān huì: happy times together.

glosses.zh: 陡顿：突然、一下子。
glosses.en: dǒu dùn: suddenly, all at once.

glosses.zh: 忧戚：忧愁悲伤。
glosses.en: yōu qī: sorrow and grief.

glosses.zh: 愁极：愁到了极点。
glosses.en: chóu jí: sorrow at its utmost.

glosses.zh: 追思：回想过去的事。
glosses.en: zhuī sī: to think back on the past.

glosses.zh: 洞房：深深的内室，女子住的房间。这里不是“新婚的房间”。
glosses.en: dòng fáng: a deep inner room where a lady lived. It does not mean a bridal chamber here.

glosses.zh: 饮散歌阑：酒席散了，歌也唱完了。阑，尽、结束。
glosses.en: yǐn sàn gē lán: the drinking ended and the songs were done. Lán means to come to an end.

glosses.zh: 鸳鸯被：绣着鸳鸯的被子。鸳鸯总是成双成对，比喻相爱的人。
glosses.en: yuān yāng bèi: a quilt embroidered with mandarin ducks, birds that always go in pairs and stand for lovers.

glosses.zh: 岂暂时疏散：哪里有一时一刻分开过？疏散，分开、冷落。
glosses.en: qǐ zàn shí shū sàn: when were we ever apart for even a moment? Shū sàn means to drift apart.

glosses.zh: 费伊心力：让她费尽了心思。伊，她。
glosses.en: fèi yī xīn lì: she spent all her heart on me. Yī means she.

glosses.zh: 殢云尤雨：形容两人非常亲密，难舍难分。
glosses.en: tì yún yóu yǔ: "clinging to the clouds and the rain", meaning two lovers who cannot bear to be apart.

glosses.zh: 万般千种：千千万万种。
glosses.en: wàn bān qiān zhǒng: thousands upon thousands of ways.

glosses.zh: 相怜相惜：互相疼爱，互相珍惜。
glosses.en: xiāng lián xiāng xī: loving and cherishing each other.

glosses.zh: 恰到如今：偏偏到了现在。
glosses.en: qià dào rú jīn: and now, of all times.

glosses.zh: 天长漏永：夜晚长得没有尽头。漏，古代用滴水来计时的器具；永，长。
glosses.en: tiān cháng lòu yǒng: the night seems endless. A lòu was a water clock; yǒng means long.

glosses.zh: 无端：没来由地，说不出为什么。
glosses.en: wú duān: for no reason at all.

glosses.zh: 自家疏隔：我们自己却分开了。自家，自己。
glosses.en: zì jiā shū gé: we ourselves have drifted apart. Zì jiā means oneself.

glosses.zh: 拥：抱着。
glosses.en: yōng: to hold in one's arms.

glosses.zh: 秦云态：像仙女一样美好的样子，指心爱的女子。
glosses.en: qín yún tài: a fairy-like beauty, meaning the beloved.

glosses.zh: 低帏昵枕：放下帐子，靠在枕边亲亲热热。帏，帐子；昵，亲近。
glosses.en: dī wéi nì zhěn: letting down the bed curtains and lying close on the pillow. Wéi is a curtain; nì means close and fond.

glosses.zh: 说与：说给她听。
glosses.en: shuō yǔ: to tell her.

glosses.zh: 江乡：江边的地方，指词人漂泊所在的南方水乡。
glosses.en: jiāng xiāng: a riverside land, the southern water country where the poet is wandering.

glosses.zh: 寒更：寒夜里的更。古代把一夜分成五更，每更大约两个小时。
glosses.en: hán gēng: the night watches of a cold night. A night was split into five watches of about two hours each.

glosses.zh: 思忆：想念。
glosses.en: sī yì: to miss someone.

translation.en: I wake from a dream:

translation.zh: 一丝风从窗缝里透进来，
translation.en: a thread of wind slips in through the window
and blows out the lonely lamp of the cold night.
How can I bear it? I have just sobered up,

translation.zh: 又听见空荡荡的台阶上，
translation.en: and again I hear, on the empty steps,

translation.zh: 夜雨一滴一滴落个不停。
translation.en: the night rain dripping on and on.
Alas, I have let things drift,
and been a wanderer at the edge of the world so long;
I have failed my beloved
and all the vows we made.
How could I bear to take
all our happy times together

translation.zh: 一下子变成了忧愁和悲伤。
translation.en: and turn them, all at once, into grief?
My sorrow is at its height.
Again and again I think back:
in her deep inner room,

translation.zh: 多少次酒宴散了，歌也唱完，
translation.en: how many times the wine was done and the songs had ended,
the mandarin-duck quilt warm and sweet;

translation.zh: 我们哪里有一刻分开过，
translation.en: when were we ever apart for a moment?
She gave me all her heart.

translation.zh: 我们那样亲密，难舍难分，
translation.en: We were so close we could not bear to part,
with a thousand thousand ways
of loving and cherishing each other.
And now, of all times,

translation.zh: 夜那么长，滴漏声没完没了，
translation.en: the night is endless and the water clock drips on,

translation.zh: 我们却说不清为什么就分开了。
translation.en: and for no reason at all we have drifted apart.
Who knows when

translation.zh: 才能再抱住她那美好的身影？
translation.en: I will hold her lovely form again?

translation.zh: 但愿那时放下帐子，靠在枕边，
translation.en: I wish that then, with the curtains down and our heads close on the pillow,
I could tell her softly, in every detail,

translation.zh: 在江边水乡的每一个夜晚，
translation.en: how every night in this riverside land

translation.zh: 我数着寒夜的更声，一直在想她。
translation.en: I counted the cold night watches, missing her.

background.zh: 柳永一生考试不顺，常年在外漂泊，写了很多羁旅和相思的词。羁旅，就是在外乡奔波、寄住。这首词写一个漂泊在南方水乡的人，半夜酒醒，听着雨声，想起远方的心上人，后悔自己一直在外，辜负了她。词里写的是他自己的经历还是一般的游子之情，具体写于哪一年、在什么地方，都已经说不清了。
background.en: Liu Yong did badly in the exams for years and spent much of his life on the road. He wrote many ci about travel far from home and about missing someone. This one shows a traveller in a southern river town. He wakes at midnight after drinking, hears the rain, and thinks of the woman he loves far away. He regrets staying away so long and letting her down. Whether it tells of his own life or of travellers in general, and when and where it was written, can no longer be said for sure.

author_note.zh: 柳永（约984—约1053），原名三变，字耆卿，排行第七，人称“柳七”，北宋词人，福建崇安人。他多次考进士都没考上，常在歌楼酒馆里为歌女写词，作品传唱很广，有“凡有井水饮处，即能歌柳词”的说法。他晚年才中进士，做过屯田员外郎，所以又叫“柳屯田”。他特别擅长写长调慢词，这首就是一例。
author_note.en: Liu Yong (about 984 – about 1053), first named Sanbian and also called Qiqing, was the seventh son, so people called him Liu Qi, "Liu the Seventh". He was a Northern Song ci poet from Chong'an in Fujian. He failed the top exam many times and often wrote songs for singing girls in wine houses. His songs spread so far that people said "wherever there is a well, people sing Liu's ci". He passed the exam only late in life and served as an official in the farm-land office, so he was also called Liu Tuntian. He was a master of long, slow ci, and this is one of them.

appreciation.zh: 这首词分三段，像一个人半夜醒来后的心事，一层一层说出来。第一段是眼前：一丝冷风吹灭了灯，酒醒了，只听见台阶上的夜雨一滴一滴落下。这样的夜，最容易想起心爱的人，也最容易后悔：自己漂泊太久，辜负了誓言，把快乐变成了忧愁。第二段回到过去：深深的内室里，酒宴散后，暖暖的被子，她为他费尽心思，两人难舍难分。第三段又回到现在：夜那么长，两人却分开了。最后他只盼望有一天能重新见到她，轻轻告诉她，自己在江边的每个夜里，都数着更声在想她。整首词没有大起大落，像雨声一样细细的、绵绵的，把思念写得很真。
appreciation.en: The ci has three parts, like the thoughts of someone who wakes at midnight, coming out layer by layer. The first part is what is around him: a thread of cold wind blows out the lamp, he has sobered up, and he hears only the night rain dripping on the steps. On such a night it is easiest to think of the one you love, and easiest to feel regret: he has wandered too long, broken his vows and turned happiness into sorrow. The second part goes back to the past: her deep inner room, the end of the feast, the warm quilt, how she gave him all her heart and they could not bear to part. The third part returns to now: the night is so long, and yet they are apart. In the end he only hopes to see her again one day and tell her softly that every night by the river he counted the night watches, missing her. There are no big ups and downs here. Like the rain, it is soft and steady, and it makes the longing feel very real.
